_comment: The knob registry: one card per tunable, so every setting is discoverable, typed and
documented in one place - including every agent's model and effort pin, which would
otherwise hide in frontmatter and drift.
checkctl's config_registry_lint enforces two tiers: ERROR when a card points at a file
or key that does not exist (a dead card is worse than no card), WARN when a scalar in a
watched file has no card (incompleteness informs, it does not block).

entries.title: Distribution generators
entries.description: Run the home-repo-only generators (demo_build, dist_build) in POLISH. True only in dot-claude-iff's own source repo: in an adopting project they would package and publish that project's private .claude/. Kits ship this false; an absent key reads as false.

entries.title: Push policy
entries.description: Whether PUBLISH pushes after committing. always: push without asking. ask (default): one question per ritual. never: commit only.

entries.title: Vault snapshots
entries.description: Take a git-bundle + chat snapshot into RECORD_ROOT/vault at PUBLISH.

entries.title: Vault retention count
entries.description: How many snapshots to keep. Older ones are reported as prunable, never auto-deleted.

entries.title: Snapshot disk guard
entries.description: Refuse a snapshot unless free disk is at least this multiple of the estimated size.

entries.title: Snapshot includes chat transcripts
entries.description: Include ~/.claude/projects/<slug>/ transcripts in the vault snapshot.

entries.title: Record root override
entries.description: Absolute path for RECORD_ROOT. null uses the sibling default <parent>/<repo>_claude_iff.

entries.title: Capture enabled
entries.description: Master switch for the capture lane. Off means no spool writes at all.

entries.title: Capture breadth
entries.description: false: the lean event set in capture_events. true: every hook event (heavier; the source system measured ~21 MB/session).

entries.title: Raw retention
entries.description: 0 keeps raw forever (the default: raw is the agent's ground truth). A positive value expires sealed raw older than N days.

entries.title: Compact sealed raw
entries.description: gzip sealed raw files (~10x smaller) instead of leaving them plain.

entries.title: Record size warning
entries.description: CHECK reports the record size loudly above this many MB. Reporting, never deleting.

entries.title: Copy transcripts verbatim
entries.description: Copy transcript files into RECORD_ROOT/raw/transcripts as the completeness backstop. Segments stay metadata-only either way.

entries.title: Ingest file cap
entries.description: 0 means no cap. A positive value bounds a single ingest run (cursors make the next run resume).

entries.title: Retrospective analysis provider
entries.description: Which model service obsctl analyze calls over the raw record. none disables it.

entries.title: Analysis model
entries.description: Model id for the analysis provider.

entries.title: Analysis base URL
entries.description: OpenAI-compatible endpoint for the analysis engine, e.g. https://openrouter.ai/api/v1 or http://localhost:11434/v1 (Ollama). Key comes from env ANALYZE_API_KEY, never from config.

entries.title: Analysis parallelism
entries.description: How many chunks are sent to the analysis endpoint concurrently.

entries.title: Analysis call timeout
entries.description: Per-chunk HTTP timeout in seconds.

entries.title: Analysis batch size
entries.description: How many raw events go into one model call.

entries.title: Billing mode
entries.description: api: per-token dollar cost applies and the price table prices it. subscription: usage is included in a plan, dollar cost reads 'in plan' and the empty-table warning goes quiet. Token counts are tracked either way.

entries.title: Console bind host
entries.description: Always a loopback address. The console serves live state; it must never be reachable off-box.

entries.title: Console port
entries.description: Port for console.py.

entries.title: Console autostart
entries.description: Start console.py from the SessionStart hook, guarded by a pidfile.

entries.title: Poll interval (active)
entries.description: Client poll cadence while the heartbeat is fresh.

entries.title: Poll interval (idle)
entries.description: Client poll cadence when the heartbeat is stale.

entries.title: Active window
entries.description: Heartbeat age below which the session counts as active.

entries.title: Anatomist model
entries.description: The .claude anatomy expert: reads components, traces relations, maintains cards, implements approved evolution changes.

entries.title: Retro-analyst model
entries.description: Evidence-gated evolution proposals, propose-only (tool-restricted, cannot write).

entries.title: Verifier model
entries.description: Adversarial claim checker; inherits the main session's model so it is never weaker than the work it checks.
